headline: T. Rowe Price (TROW) Faces Fresh Questions After Airtable Sale
summary: Bending Spoons agreed to acquire Airtable, a private software company, in a deal described by market commentators as part of a recent “SaaSpocalypse” wave of transactions. T. Rowe Price Group, listed as NasdaqGS:TROW, invested in Airtable during earlier funding rounds, which leaves its funds exposed to the terms of this sale. The deal reportedly led to substantial losses for several Airtable investors, although the specific impact on T. Rowe Price has not been detailed. T. Rowe Price Group...

headline: T. Rowe Price (TROW) Stock Looks Cheap On Value While Outflows Cloud Earnings
summary: T. Rowe Price Group stock has recovered over the past three years, yet after a share price that is still down 33.7% over five years, the current valuation screens as cheap on both intrinsic value checks and earnings multiples. The question for investors is whether that apparent discount properly reflects the risks around its investing track record and fee based business model.
